events.headline: DOS BARCOS COMERCIALES SON ATACADOS POR DRONES EN EL MAR NEGRO

events.headline: US WARSHIPS HAVE ‘FLED’ STRAIT OF HORMUZ – IRGC
events.detail: Iran’s IRGC says US warships withdrew from the Strait of Hormuz and nearby waters as the naval blockade and diplomatic deadlock continue Read Full Article at RT.com
